import numpy as np, math, json
from PIL import Image
from rcb_robolab import quat_to_mat

def show(s, label):
    print(label, json.dumps(s.objects()), 'EE', s.ee_pose(), 'grip', s.gripper_angle(), 'status', s.status(), flush=True)
    Image.fromarray(s.render_grid()).save('/app/output/'+label+'.png')

def centre(s, name):
    return s.object_bounds(name).mean(axis=0)

def face_yaw(s, p, name):
    R = quat_to_mat(s.object_pose(name)[1])
    cols = [R[:,i] for i in range(3) if abs(R[2,i]) < .3]
    d = min(cols, key=lambda v:abs(p['yaw_for_closing_dir'](v[:2])))
    return p['yaw_for_closing_dir'](d[:2])

def move(s, p, pos, q, speed=.15):
    print('move', np.round(pos,4), 'speed', speed, flush=True)
    p['move_ee'](pos,q,speed=speed,tol=.0015,rot_tol=.025,max_steps=180,settle=3)

def stack_one(s,p,name,base):
    q = p['top_down_quat'](face_yaw(s,p,name))
    c = centre(s,name)
    b = s.object_bounds(name)
    grasp = c.copy(); grasp[2] = b[0,2]+.009
    print('grasp',name,'centre',c,'tcp',grasp,'yaw',face_yaw(s,p,name),flush=True)
    p['open_gripper'](10)
    move(s,p,[c[0],c[1],.22],q)
    move(s,p,grasp,q,.07)
    p['close_gripper'](18)
    show(s,'grasp_'+name)
    move(s,p,[c[0],c[1],.23],q,.09)
    p['hold'](8)
    show(s,'lift_'+name)
    held = centre(s,name); tcp = s.ee_pose()[0]
    offset = held-tcp
    dest = centre(s,base)
    h = s.object_bounds(name)[1,2]-s.object_bounds(name)[0,2]
    dest[2] = s.object_bounds(base)[1,2]+h/2+.004
    goal = dest-offset
    move(s,p,[goal[0],goal[1],.23],q,.10)
    move(s,p,goal,q,.05)
    show(s,'place_'+name)
    p['open_gripper'](18)
    p['hold'](12)
    show(s,'release_'+name)
    move(s,p,[goal[0],goal[1],.23],q,.08)
    p['hold'](8)
    show(s,'done_'+name)
